material.properties_basis: SSAB 355J2H material product, 3-12.5 mm wall; ambient elastic coefficients and density from SSAB handbook section 1.6.3. Custom bent/welded members still require material certificates and joint/HAZ qualification.

screen_policy.contact: Unilateral vertical reactions at actual sole polygon vertices; no fixed root/ground torque. Gravity-only quasistatics.
screen_policy.articulations: Wrench demands at current geometric joints; no actuator torque limits or stiffness assigned. Required holding torque is not supplied automatically.
screen_policy.load_cases: External 2/3-tonne equivalent crown compression is a structural test demand, not a rated lifting payload. A 1.5 multiplier is a sensitivity case, not a certified dynamic factor.

reserve_basis: Explicit sensitivity allowances covering unselected drives/internal bearings, battery, thermal, wiring/mounts and electronics. Excludes the separately modeled primary boxes and frame-side steel shaft sockets. Not measured or supplier-validated; no historical B mass imported. Existing decorative mechanism solids are not also counted as filled steel. Exact drive envelopes and assembly trims remain red.
armor_basis: Actual current thin-cover/plate mesh volumes times a broad conditional material-density range. Appearance skin thickness is not manufacturing-approved. No physical claim about a chosen armor material.
